root.label: Random numbers
root.note: Engines produce bits, distributions shape them, and the seed decides the start.

children.label: Three parts
children.note: Generator, distribution and seed are separate objects with separate failure modes.

children.label: Engines
children.note: Deterministic state machines: same seed gives the same sequence on every implementation.

children.label: Adaptors
children.note: discard_block, independent_bits and shuffle_order engines wrap another engine.

children.label: Distributions
children.note: Turn engine output into values; the algorithm is not specified, so results vary by library.

children.label: Predefined check value
children.note: The 10000th call of a default mt19937 returns 4123659995.

children.label: Why not rand()
children.note: std::rand has hidden global state and implementation-defined quality.

children.label: Modulo bias
children.note: rand() % n favors some residues unless n divides RAND_MAX + 1.

children.label: Small RAND_MAX
children.note: RAND_MAX is only guaranteed to be at least 32767.

children.label: random_shuffle removed
children.note: It used rand and was removed in C++17; use shuffle with an engine.

children.label: Seeding
children.note: A program's randomness cannot exceed its seed's.

children.label: random_device
children.note: Meant to be non-deterministic, but may be a fixed pseudo-random engine on some platforms.

children.label: Single 32-bit seed
children.note: Reaches at most 2^32 of mt19937's states; 1<<32 and 0 give the same engine.

children.label: seed_seq
children.note: Spreads seed words over the engine state but cannot add entropy.

children.label: Distribution rules
children.note: Interval conventions and permitted types differ per distribution.

children.label: Integer is closed
children.note: uniform_int_distribution gives [a, b] and needs a <= b, else undefined behavior.

children.label: Real is half-open
children.note: uniform_real_distribution gives [a, b), but rounding has returned b in some libraries.

children.label: Allowed int types
children.note: Only short, int, long, long long and unsigned forms; char and bool are undefined.

children.label: State and reset
children.note: Distributions may cache values, as normal does; reset discards the cache.

children.label: Algorithms and threads
children.note: Shuffle and sample take a generator, and generators are not thread-safe.

children.label: shuffle
children.note: Permutes a range with a generator; results differ between libraries.

children.label: sample
children.note: C++17 selection without replacement; stable only for forward iterators.

children.label: Thread safety
children.note: Concurrent calls on one engine or distribution race; use one engine per thread.

children.label: C++26
children.note: Counter-based generation for parallel work.

children.label: philox_engine
children.note: Counter-based engine with philox4x32 and philox4x64 aliases.

children.label: generate_random
children.note: Ranges algorithm that fills a range from a generator; not in GCC 16.2.
